# MovieChannel <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Movies](BlitzBasic-Movies)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MovieChannel:Int32 movie:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `movie` | In | Int32 | required | A movie handle from [OpenMovie](OpenMovie). |

**Returns:** The channel, `0` for a movie without sound or without a sound device. It stays the same until [CloseMovie](CloseMovie), across [SeekMovie](SeekMovie) and loops.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Gives the channel that the sound of a movie plays on, for the channel commands: [ChannelVolume](ChannelVolume) (the same volume as [MovieVolume](MovieVolume)), [ChannelPan](ChannelPan), [ChannelBus](ChannelBus), [ChannelRadius](ChannelRadius) and [ChannelPlaying](ChannelPlaying). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* The movie plays, pauses and stops its sound: [StopChannel](StopChannel), [PauseChannel](PauseChannel), [ResumeChannel](ResumeChannel) and [ChannelPitch](ChannelPitch) on it are runtime errors, and [StopAudioBus](StopAudioBus) leaves it alone.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
movie = OpenMovie("advert.mp4")
ChannelPan MovieChannel(movie), -1 ; only on the left speaker
```
